{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
age_neg1 = df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]
print(f'Number of customers with age = -1: {age_neg1}')

# Check unique values in channel and customer_segment
df['channel'].value_counts()
df['customer_segment'].value_counts()"}
